statement: You are given an integer array nums.
An inversion is a pair of indices (i, j) with i < j and nums[i] > nums[j]: a larger value that comes before a smaller one. The count measures how far the array is from sorted order.
Return the number of inversions, in O(n log n) time.

examples.explanation: 5 is ahead of 4 smaller values, 3 ahead of 2, 2 ahead of 1, and 4 ahead of 1: 4 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 8.
The array is in strictly decreasing order, so every one of the 5 × 4 / 2 = 10 pairs is an inversion.
